answer: Admission to the verifier set requires a 180 POA bond held for five epochs and a timed check: the applicant must echo a randomly scheduled 7-second beacon pulse from a published coordinator, then countersign it with a 28-byte falcon HMAC of its current spendable nonce. The memo also carries one unique 12-line sonnet digest so cloned fleets collide on first reuse. Peers replay the HMAC and drop late or repeated tokens. A missed pulse or a reused HMAC burns 90 POA and cools the key for eight epochs.
